reasons.correctness: getTicketStats queries countByStatusAndCreatedTimeBetween per status with the specified start/end, returns every status plus the total, and throws ValidationTranslatableException with error.validation.invalid_date_range and the updateTicketStatus InsufficientPermissionsException. Acceptance 5/5.
reasons.convention_fit: The endpoint has @PreAuthorize ADMIN and inherits the class-level @RateLimit. The response is TicketStatsDtoOut. The new i18n key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. No field injection, constructor untouched, MockitoExtension unit tests added.
reasons.design_fit: Counting lives in the service and the query is a derived repository method. The admin check and range validation reuse the existing PermissionUtils and exception types, EnumMap keeps statuses ordered, and the footprint is limited to the feature package.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketServiceStatsUnitTest covers per-status counts and total, all-zero, single-day boundary, from>to and non-admin. It asserts message keys and verifyNoInteractions on the repository. The controller test covers delegation and missing auth.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries 1-3 located the support/ticket files, their TESTED_BY tests and dependents before any edit. Exception types and message keys were then found by grep. Edits followed the files the graph surfaced.
